## Schema.dropAllTables() method

Drop every table — the destructive half of `migrate:fresh`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
dropAllTables(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

## Remarks

Includes the migrations tracking table, so the next run starts from batch one. Foreign key order is handled per dialect: `CASCADE` on Postgres, suspended constraint checks on MySQL and sqlite.
